title: x402 escrow: refund the payer or pay the merchant?
question: Should the payer receive the disputed amount, or should the merchant?

answers.title: Refund the payer
answers.description: The resource was not delivered, or the delivery materially differs from the offer. The disputed amount goes back to the payer.

answers.title: Pay the merchant
answers.description: The delivery satisfies the offer, or the payer did not prove otherwise. The disputed amount goes to the merchant.
